criterion: Visible content (skins, faces, decals) distorts at most 15 % under any morph. Measured on what is drawn, not on the body surface under fixed UV0.

uv0.overlap: rejected by art/gel_character/gel_body_validation.py (UV0 triangles overlap check)
uv0.layout: one island per face (build_gel_body.py decorate), used only to read thickness.png
uv0.surface_change_under_fixed_uv0: geometry_metrics.json keeps uv_passes_15_percent=false (max scale 61.14 %, anisotropy 230.09 % at general_thickness). That is the body surface itself growing; thickness.png must follow it and no texture drawn on the body uses UV0.

zone_mask.attribute: COLOR_0 / Blender GelZone, per vertex, fixed under morphs
zone_mask.checks: every vertex in one zone; head > neck > torso > leg > foot by height; hands outside arms outside torso

skins.sampling: model_position = deformed VERTEX in gel_body.gdshader and gel_body_opaque.gdshader
skins.note: Object-space patterns keep their size on any morph; the only UV read in both shaders is texture(thickness_map, UV).

decals: No body decal exists. A future decal must be projected in model space like the skins, or it inherits the body surface change above.

before.note: GelFace.apply_proportions was never called by the player or the preview and its constants assumed +1 was wider; the real morph makes +1 narrower (x/z 0.84) and taller (y 1.16), so the face floated about 4 cm off (+1) or sank about 3 cm in (-1). A plain non-uniform scale fitted to the real head would have distorted the drawing by 38 %.

after.method: the curved patch is rebuilt on the morphed head ellipsoid; rows move to the latitude whose meridian arc is the uniform scale sqrt(width*height) times the rest arc and each row's longitude span is corrected by its circle radius

not_verified: No new rendered captures: Godot only ran headless.
Hair, eyebrows, moustache, costume and ragdoll head fitting still use the inverted head_shape sign (+1 wider); separate task.
